subject: Clarify: notification window, cross-border handoff & subprocessor obligations (FinTrail)
messages:
From: Olivia Park <olivia.park@fintrail.com>
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
Cc: security@fintrail.com, legal@fintrail.com
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Possible exposure of customer tokens — initial report

Hi Mateo,

We noticed anomalous token activity in our test environment that calls Redwood endpoints tied to a small set of customer API keys. At this point we don't have evidence of exfiltration, but logs show repeated partial KV cache reads from a single external IP. Can you confirm whether this maps to any internal process or subprocessor activity? Our security team asked for: (1) expected notification window under our DPA; (2) whether you can provide a locked-forensics export and list of subprocessors who might have handled the traffic; and (3) your proposed cooperation timeline for triage and evidence transfer.

We have a tight regulator-driven 72-hour initial notification requirement. Appreciate a rapid call if helpful.

Thanks,
Olivia
Security Ops
FinTrail

---
Attachment: sample_log_excerpt.txt (text)

From: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com
To: Olivia Park <olivia.park@fintrail.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Possible exposure of customer tokens — initial report

Olivia —

Thanks for flagging and for the log snippet. We're treating this as a privacy incident candidate and will follow the DPA escalation flow. Quick summary of actions we're initiating now: 

- Triage: I asked Ops to snapshot the runtime instance and start a locked-forensics export (ETA 4 hours).
- Evidence: we'll include network logs, token access traces, and a KV-cache export.
- Notification window: per our DPA we commit to "initial notification" within 72 hours of confirmed customer-impacting events; our proposed timeline here is that we'll provide an initial incident summary within 48 hours (preliminary findings) and a follow-up with evidence bundle within 96 hours unless the scope requires longer. We can accelerate if you need the 72-hour regulator trigger — tell us which timestamp you prefer us to use.
- Subprocessors: attaching current subprocessor_list.csv; we will confirm whether any subprocessors had route-level access to the affected model pool.

I'll coordinate legal and product for any contractual clarifications. Proposed next step: 30-minute war-room call if you can do 11:30 PT.

Mateo Alvarez
Security & Partnerships (redwood mail alias)
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: subprocessor_list.csv (csv)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, Olivia Park <olivia.park@fintrail.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Possible exposure of customer tokens — initial report

Olivia/Mateo —

Legal here. Two quick contractual points to be explicit about while we triage: 

1) "Initial notification" language in our baseline DPA (Section 5.2) is subject to internal verification steps; we aim to avoid false positives. That said, we will treat your 72-hour regulator window as a high priority. If FinTrail needs a formal "notice of incident" to regulators, confirm whether you consider the time of your detection (14 Aug 09:12 PT) or the time of our confirmed evidence transfer as the regulator trigger point. We can backstop either but will note the timestamp in the formal notice.

2) Cross-border evidence handoff: our export will be a locked bundle. We will provide secure transfer (pre-signed S3 + short-lived credentials) and a chain-of-custody manifest. If FinTrail requires escrow or an independent third-party forensic review, raise that now — we can propose a rotated list of approved vendors.

We will not share raw customer PII beyond what is necessary for triage. Ben — please include technical scope and expected artifacts in the next message.

Laura Bennett
Counsel, Privacy & Security
Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: mateo_alvarez@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Olivia Park <olivia.park@fintrail.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Date: Sat, 14 Aug 2027 12:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Possible exposure of customer tokens — initial report

Team / Olivia —

Technical update: ops pulled the runtime snapshot and we're seeing an unusual pattern of HEAD requests to the model serving layer that align with KV-cache lookups. Planned deliverables: 

- Preliminary findings doc (short): key endpoints, IPs, affected keys, and whether requests resulted in full token retrieval or only metadata (ETA 48 hrs).
- Forensics export: exported_kv_cache.tar.gz (redacted where possible), network pcap slice, and an operation manifest.
- Evidence format and delivery: signed manifest + pre-signed S3 links; if FinTrail prefers direct SFTP or an escrow provider, confirm link below.

Regarding subprocessors: early trace indicates traffic originated from a cloud workload in our partner cluster. That cluster is handled by a third-party infra partner listed in subprocessor_list.csv. We'll verify whether any of their personnel had access to production keys.

Grace — please start preparing the evidence bundle and the chain-of-custody. Olivia — if you confirm you need the 72-hour regulator timestamp to be 09:12 PT on Aug 14, we'll prioritize getting the initial notice out within 72 hours (so by Aug 17 09:12 PT). Otherwise we'll issue preliminary findings within 48 hrs and the full bundle within 96 hrs.

Ben Carter
VP, Platform Reliability
Redwood Inference

Thanks — we've reviewed and FinTrail will treat the detection timestamp (14 Aug 09:12 PT) as the regulator trigger. Please proceed with the 72-hour notice cadence. Two asks before you send any formal notice: 

1) Confirm whether any subprocessor outside the US had access to the affected cluster during the time window (we need this for cross-border notice rules).
2) Provide the chain-of-custody manifest and an export link with user-level audit logs for who downloaded or accessed the bundle.

We also need a single consolidated point of contact for our legal team to coordinate the DPA amendment for notification SLA and export controls. I can countersign a short DPA amendment; please send via DocuSign.

Olivia Park
Head, Security Ops
FinTrail
